jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description: About Conveo Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams. The Context Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load. That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US. You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting. Your Mission 1. Own the People systems stack and make it work across every country You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies. Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement 2. Build an employee lifecycle that feels effortless at 2x our size Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in. Des

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: About the role Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Recruiter to be the face of Taktile for our future team members. Your primary responsibilities will include sourcing, recruiting, and managing the candidate journey to ensure we attract and hire exceptional talent. As a key driver of our growth, your work will directly influence the success and scalability of our operations. This role is perfect for someone eager to play a central role in shaping Taktile's organization. We are looking for a skilled recruiter who knows how to identify and attract top talent and who thrives in the fast-moving, competitive landscape of AI. This role is based in our London or Berlin office. We believe great recruiting is highly collaborative and relationship-driven, so we work together in person at least three days per week. What You'll Do Own the full recruiting cycle for a portfolio of GTM roles, from role scoping with hiring managers through offer close, moving fast without sacrificing quality or candidate experience. Build and execute sourcing strategies tailored to each role, using LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-assisted tools, and creative outreach to reach both active and passive candidates. Act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, not just an executor. That means shaping job requirements, challenging assumptions, and keeping searches on track when priorities shift. Deliver a standout candidate experience at every touchpoint: clear communication, timely feedback, and a process that reflects Taktile's values even when we're moving quickly. Leverage data to drive decisions. Track pipeline health, identify drop-off points, and share regular hiring funnel updates that lead to action, not just reporting. jobs.description: Your Role in Our Story:    As a Senior Recruiter at ACT, you will attract and hire commercial talent, primarily -and not alone- for our Front Office teams. You will manage the recruitment process from intake to offer, working closely with hiring managers to understand their business, challenge requirements and turn hiring needs into effective recruitment strategies. You understand our markets and what motivates people working in environmental commodities, energy and trading. You use this knowledge to identify talent, build relationships and give practical advice on how to attract the right candidates.   Own the full recruitment cycle, primarily for Front Office positions, including sales, trading and business development. Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, agree on selection criteria and keep recruitment moving. Proactively source and engage candidates, building talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs. Bring market knowledge into hiring discussions, advising on talent availability, competitor activity and candidate expectations. Conduct thorough interviews and support objective, consistent hiring decisions. Deliver a positive candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback and careful follow-up. Keep Greenhouse accurate and up to date, using recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and improve results. Work closely with fellow recruiters, HR and Employer Branding, sharing knowledge and contributing to team priorities.   Your Expertise:  To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes: 3–5 years of recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for commercial or Front Office positions. jobs.title: Talent Analyst Specialist (Fully Remote)
jobs.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Talent Analyst Specialist Remote (Philippines) | Reports to: VP of People ABOUT THE ROLE We hire fast, and we're getting bigger every quarter. That only works if the people making hiring decisions can see clearly. Which channels produce great candidates. Where offers stall. How headcount plans track against budget. What our employer brand actually says to the market. This role builds that clarity. You'll stand up the talent analytics function from the ground up, set the data standards our hiring systems run on, and design the collateral that helps strong candidates say yes. It's part analyst, part systems owner, part brand builder, and you'll be the person leadership comes to when they want a real answer about hiring. The work is hard for a good reason. Talent data lives across an ATS, an HRIS, sourcing tools, a finance model, and more spreadsheets than anyone wants to admit, and none of them fully agree with each other. You'll decide what good data looks like, get the organization to hold that standard, and turn it into reporting people actually open on a Monday morning. You'll also own the story we tell candidates, and you'll know whether that story is working because you'll be measuring it. WHAT YOU’LL OWN Talent Analytics Build the talent analytics function at Luxury Presence, from metric definitions through to the dashboards recruiters and leaders use every week Define the talent KPIs that matter, including time to fill, pipeline conversion, source quality, offer acceptance, and quality of hire, and set the targets we hold ourselves to Automate reporting so it refreshes itself and nobody spends Friday re

jobs.title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
jobs.description: Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening. Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel! Wat ga je doen? Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs. Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening. Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort: Vraagbaak voor het HR-team : je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s. Samenwerken met de teamleider HR : je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten. Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers :
